variables.name: FlowRunHistoryLink
variables.value: Link to Run History

parameters.specification/query: EVALUATE SELECTCOLUMNS(FILTER('Functional Locations', 'Functional Locations'[Functional Location] IN {@{join(body('Select_FL_list'), ',')}}), "FL", 'Functional Locations'[Functional Location], "Description", 'Functional Locations'[Functional Location Description], "PlantKey", 'Functional Locations'[Plant Key], "SystemNo", 'Functional Locations'[Plant Section Key])

Reason.inputs: @if(equals(length(body('Filter_FL_rows')), 0), concat('FL ', outputs('FL'), ' is not in the system model'), if(not(equals(toUpper(outputs('PlantKey')), toUpper(coalesce(triggerBody()?['PlantsInitial/Value'], '')))), concat('FL ', outputs('FL'), ' belongs to ', outputs('PlantKey'), ', the plan is for ', coalesce(triggerBody()?['PlantsInitial/Value'], '')), if(equals(length(body('Filter_approver_rows')), 0), concat('System ', outputs('SysNo'), ' has no approver in the list'), if(and(empty(outputs('Approver_email1')), empty(outputs('Approver_email2'))), concat('System ', outputs('SysNo'), ' has no valid approver in the list'), ''))))

parameters.item/Detail: @concat('Requester is 1st or 2nd approver for system ', outputs('SysNo'), ': ', outputs('Creator'))

parameters.WebhookApprovalCreationInput/itemLinkDes: Open the plan in the app

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: @concat('Reminder: maintenance plan ', triggerBody()?['PlanID'], ' is waiting for your approval')
parameters.emailMessage/Body: The system approval of item '@{items('For_each_item')?['Title']}' (@{outputs('FL')}) in maintenance plan @{triggerBody()?['PlanID']} has not been answered. Respond in Teams under Approvals or in the email from Power Automate.

parameters.item/Detail: @concat('System ', outputs('SysNo'), ' has no approver found in Office 365')
parameters.item/Comment: @concat('System ', outputs('SysNo'), ' has no approver found in Office 365')

parameters.$filter: PlanId eq @{triggerBody()?['ID']} and Stage eq 'System' and Title eq '@{workflow()?['run']?['name']}'

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: @concat('Maintenance plan ', triggerBody()?['PlanID'], ' returned - correct it and submit again')
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Maintenance plan @{triggerBody()?['PlanID']} (@{triggerBody()?['Title']}) was returned by the system approval:

@{replace(replace(replace(outputs('Return_comment'), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>')}

Correct the plan in the app and submit it again.

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: An error occured in the flow - @{workflow()?['tags']?['flowDisplayName']}
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Hi,

An error was detected in the following flow instance (plan @{triggerBody()?['PlanID']}).

>Timestamp
@{body('Convert_UTC_time_to_DK_time_zone')}

>Run History
@{variables('FlowRunHistoryLink')}

Thank you
